VehicleComponentParams.vehicleDescription:
Manufacturer: RSI
Focus: Snub Fighter

The Skylark snub fighter was built to be the ultimate companion for the Constellation Mk V. With a complimentary style and shape, the Skylark can be docked and accessed directly from its parent ship. It also features highly maneuverable thrusters to keep it nimble and a spirited weapons package that includes a robust missile payload.
